archetypes.name: cleanup-security
archetypes.rationale: Cache cleanup adds filesystem deletion with confinement invariants.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /upgrade-larch cleanup path for filesystem safety. Focus on version-root resolution, symlink handling, direct-child directory deletion, and whether any candidate can escape the canonical cache version root. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: upgrade-flow
archetypes.rationale: Cleanup must run on already-latest and unverified post-install paths without changing upgrade success semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review run_main control flow around already-latest, reinstall, unverified install, stamp, prune, and restart markers. Check that cleanup runs in the intended places and remains independent of stable-version verification while prune remains gated. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: docs-sync
archetypes.rationale: The sparse allowlist has several manually synchronized prose surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the sparse allowlist and cleanup behavior across docs, skills, SECURITY.md, shell constants, Python constants, and tests. Look for stale commands, overbroad install-time claims, and mismatches between SessionStart drift wording and upgrade cleanup behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
